title: kp-world-heavyweight-kombat-pro-2009
label: Shinsuke Nakamura

won.source: K-PRO's own Desperado tour coverage, served at /promotions/kombat-pro-2009/archive/kombat-pro-new-generation-desperado-2009-07-06.html, names Nakamura as the reigning KP World Heavyweight Champion; no document read this pass records the tournament final that crowned him.

note: Billed as KP World Heavyweight Champion by K-PRO's own Desperado tour coverage, defending the title he won in the tournament announced on KOMBAT-PRO's first show.

title: kp-world-jr-heavyweight-kombat-pro-2009
label: KENTA

won.source: K-PRO's own Desperado tour coverage, served at /promotions/kombat-pro-2009/archive/kombat-pro-new-generation-desperado-2009-07-06.html, bills KENTA as champion entering his second successful defense.

note: Retained the KP World Jr. Heavyweight Championship against Shuji Kondo on 6 July 2009 with the Go 2 Sleep.

title: kp-world-trios-kombat-pro-2009
label: No Remorse Corps

won.source: K-PRO's own Desperado tour coverage, served at /promotions/kombat-pro-2009/archive/kombat-pro-new-generation-desperado-2009-07-06.html, bills the No Remorse Corps as champions entering their second successful defense.
